test_value: A 17-month continuous discharge carried as ~240 near-identical daily UPDATEs; the workbook end time is set to 05/30/2027 (placeholder). The site needs an 'ongoing' state keyed on the chain, not one event per notice.

test_value: Shared water with Connecticut. Reason 'Short Term Partial Blend Wet Weather Event'. The Update that ends the chain is labelled Update, not Close. Final volume is 9x the first estimate. The plant filed six more such chains through Aug 2026 (e.g. Mar 16-17 10,000,000 est -> 1,523,390 actual; Aug 21 5,000,000 est -> 2,426,530 actual), so the first-notice figure is a placeholder, not a forecast. Note 6 NYCRR 750-2.7 exempts partially treated POTW discharges 'in compliance with a department approved plan or permit' from public notice, yet these were sent.
